changeSet.author: eduar.troyano
changeSet.comment: Crea la tabla resources: recursos de texto y video por tema, compartidos o personales de una inscripción, con versión y revisión. Incluye secuencia propia, tabla de auditoría resources_audit y el trigger resources_audit_trg.

createTable.remarks: Text and video resources of a topic; shared among learners or personal to an enrollment

column.name: id
column.remarks: Primary key

column.name: public_id
column.remarks: Public identifier exposed by the API instead of the sequential id

column.name: topic_id
column.remarks: Topic the resource belongs to

column.name: resource_type
column.remarks: Resource type: text or video

column.name: kind
column.remarks: Kind: main, remedial or personal_example

column.name: audience
column.remarks: Audience: all_learners or enrollment

column.name: enrollment_id
column.remarks: Enrollment the resource is personal to; null when shared

column.name: version
column.remarks: Version of the resource, incremented on regeneration

column.name: review_status
column.remarks: Review status: pending_review, approved or retired

column.name: url
column.remarks: Resource URL (videos)

column.name: content
column.remarks: Generated text content

column.name: faithfulness
column.remarks: Faithfulness score of the content to its sources (0 to 1)

column.name: unsupported_claims
column.remarks: Claims not supported by the sources

column.name: sources
column.remarks: Sources cited by the generated content (RAG)

column.name: prompt_version
column.remarks: Version of the prompt that generated the resource

column.name: edited_by_user_id
column.remarks: Instructor that edited the resource

column.name: video_candidate_id
column.remarks: Video candidate the resource is based on

column.name: active
column.remarks: Logical state: false means deactivated (rows are never deleted)

column.name: created_at
column.remarks: Creation timestamp

column.name: updated_at
column.remarks: Last update timestamp, maintained by the set_updated_at trigger

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE resources ADD CONSTRAINT resources_type_ck CHECK (resource_type IN ('text', 'video'))
ALTER TABLE resources ADD CONSTRAINT resources_kind_ck CHECK (kind IN ('main', 'remedial', 'personal_example'))
ALTER TABLE resources ADD CONSTRAINT resources_audience_ck CHECK (audience IN ('all_learners', 'enrollment'))
ALTER TABLE resources ADD CONSTRAINT resources_audience_enrollment_ck CHECK ((audience = 'enrollment') = (enrollment_id IS NOT NULL))
ALTER TABLE resources ADD CONSTRAINT resources_review_status_ck CHECK (review_status IN ('pending_review', 'approved', 'retired'))
ALTER TABLE resources ADD CONSTRAINT resources_faithfulness_ck CHECK (faithfulness IS NULL OR faithfulness BETWEEN 0 AND 1)
ALTER TABLE resources ADD CONSTRAINT resources_url_or_content_ck CHECK (url IS NOT NULL OR content IS NOT NULL)
CREATE TRIGGER resources_set_updated_at_trg BEFORE UPDATE ON resources FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

column.name: audit_id
column.remarks: Primary key of the audit row

column.name: record_id
column.remarks: Id of the audited row in resources

column.name: operation
column.remarks: INSERT, UPDATE or DELETE

column.name: old_data
column.remarks: Row before the change

column.name: new_data
column.remarks: Row after the change

column.name: changed_at
column.remarks: Moment of the change

column.name: db_user
column.remarks: Database user that made the change

column.name: app_user_id
column.remarks: Application user that made the change (smartmentor.current_user_id)

changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE resources_audit ADD CONSTRAINT resources_audit_operation_ck CHECK (operation IN ('INSERT', 'UPDATE', 'DELETE'))
CREATE TRIGGER resources_audit_trg AFTER INSERT OR UPDATE OR DELETE ON resources FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION audit_row_change()

rollback.sql: DROP TRIGGER IF EXISTS resources_audit_trg ON resources
